stories.title: “I know this will not be popular”: councillor makes the case for Flint super-school
stories.summary: An independent Flintshire councillor has defended the need for the authority to press ahead with its Catholic super-school plans. Cllr Bill Crease, who represents Connah’s Quay South, is deputy leader of the Independent Group which is part of Flintshire County Council’s leadership coalition. stories.title: Families urged to check eligibility for School Essentials Grant ahead of September term
stories.summary: With the September term fast approaching, families across Wales are being urged to find out if they are eligible for support from the School Essentials Grant. stories.title: Solar eclipse over Deeside reaches maximum at 7.10pm on Wednesday
stories.summary: Ninety-two per cent of the sun will be covered over Deeside at 7.10pm on Wednesday, in the deepest solar eclipse seen from this part of Wales since 1999. stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has opened a 12-week consultation asking people which walking, wheeling and cycling routes should be built or improved across the county. stories.title: Motorcycle recorded at 127mph on A494 in Mold, North Wales Police say
stories.summary: A motorcycle was recorded travelling at 127mph on the A494 in Mold during police patrols at the weekend. North Wales Police Roads Policing Unit said a second motorcycle was recorded at 97mph on the same stretch of road, carrying a pillion passenger.
